quotes: Our experiments cover a wide range of tasks, from natural language understanding (NLU) to generation (NLG).
We use NVIDIA Tesla V100 for all experiments.
As shown in Table 4, LoRA matches or exceeds the fine-tuning baseline on all three datasets.
data.text: 实验覆盖 RoBERTa base/large 与 DeBERTa XXL 的 GLUE、GPT-2 medium/large 的 E2E NLG（另含 WebNLG、DART），并扩展到 GPT-3 175B 的 WikiSQL、MultiNLI 与 SAMSum，全部在 NVIDIA Tesla V100 上训练。GPT-3 上 LoRA（4.7M 可训练参数）取得 WikiSQL 73.4、MultiNLI-m 91.7、SAMSum R1/R2/RL 53.8/29.8/45.9，与全量微调的 73.8、89.5、52.0/28.0/44.5 相当或更好。DeBERTa XXL 上 LoRA 仅用 4.7M 参数就把 GLUE 平均分做到 91.3，略高于全量微调的 91.1。

quotes: However, we do not expect a small r to work for every task or dataset.
We mostly depend on heuristics to select the weight matrices to apply LoRA to.
The mechanism behind fine-tuning or LoRA is far from clear – how are features learned during pre-training transformed to do well on downstream tasks?
While a thorough investigation into this phenomenon is out-of-scope for this work
limitations.text: “该把 LoRA 加到哪些权重矩阵”以及秩 r 的选取仍主要依赖启发式规则，小秩并非对所有任务都成立，例如下游任务语言与预训练语言不同时，接近满秩的重训练可能更好。低秩有效性的解释主要是经验性的子空间相似度分析，微调/LoRA 起作用的内在机制仍不清楚。实验只覆盖 Transformer 的注意力权重（MLP 被冻结），并且对特殊 token 过多导致性能下降的现象明确未做深入研究。

quotes: LoRA allows us to train some dense layers in a neural network indirectly by optimizing rank decomposition matrices
In principle, we can apply LoRA to any subset of weight matrices in a neural network to reduce the number of trainable parameters.
We limit our study to only adapting the attention weights for downstream tasks and freeze the MLP modules
method.text: LoRA 冻结预训练权重 W0，把权重更新重参数化为低秩分解 ΔW=BA（B 为 d×r、A 为 r×k，r 远小于 min(d,k)），前向变成 h=W0x+BAx，只训练 A、B。A 用高斯初始化、B 置零，使训练开始时 ΔW 为零；ΔWx 再按 α/r 缩放，从而在改变 r 时减少超参数重调。推理时把 BA 显式加回 W0，任务切换只需替换低秩矩阵，因此不增加推理延迟；实验主要把 LoRA 施加于注意力的 Wq、Wv，并冻结 MLP。

metrics.name: 可训练参数减少倍数（GPT-3 175B）
metrics.quote: Compared to GPT-3 175B fine-tuned with Adam, LoRA can reduce the number of trainable parameters by 10,000 times and the GPU memory requirement by 3 times.

metrics.name: GPU 显存需求降低
metrics.quote: LoRA makes training more efficient and lowers the hardware barrier to entry by up to 3 times when using adaptive optimizers since we do not need to calculate the gradients or maintain the optimizer states for most parameters.

metrics.quote: storing 100 adapted models only requires 350GB + 35MB * 100 ≈ 354GB as opposed to 100 * 350GB ≈ 35TB.

quotes: Using GPT-3 175B as an example -- deploying independent instances of fine-tuned models, each with 175B parameters, is prohibitively expensive.
As we pre-train larger models, full fine-tuning, which retrains all model parameters, becomes less feasible.
often introduce inference latency (Houlsby et al., 2019; Rebuffi et al., 2017) by extending model depth or reduce the model’s usable sequence length
problem.text: 大规模预训练语言模型要为每个下游任务做全量微调，每个任务都要保存并部署一份与原始模型同样大的参数副本；以 GPT-3 175B 为例，这种部署方式成本高到不可行。已有参数高效方法（adapter、prefix 类）往往引入推理延迟或缩短可用序列长度，且常常达不到全量微调的质量。作者由此假设：模型适配时的权重变化具有很低的“内在秩”，可以把任务增量压缩成小得多的参数集合。

title: LoRA: Low-Rank Adaptation of Large Language Models
